headline: Highest risk is data leakage/capability conflict uncertainty: both docs-only open-source agents show no egress, but shared-workspace and handoff pathways are undocumented.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel, filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is documented for either ai-engineering-hub or taipy. With both profiles showing empty io_surfaces and no runnable integration evidence, a prompt-injection pathway is not provable.
conditions: IF a shared clipboard, filesystem, or MCP bridge is later configured between the two agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Document any future handoff channel before enabling it.
Use manual copy-paste only for short, reviewed snippets.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles show network_egress set to none and no data classes touched, so there is no documented path for either ai-engineering-hub or taipy to exfiltrate shared data by default. Because no shared workspace is documented, leakage is not evidenced.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, leakage risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Do not place sensitive files in any shared directory.
Verify outbound network remains disabled for both agents.
Review any future connector that can read local files.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: The profiles do not document overlapping write surfaces, git access, databases, or OAuth scopes for either ai-engineering-hub or taipy. With io_surfaces empty and concurrency_model empty, a write-write conflict is not established.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or mutable resource, conflict risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Avoid shared mutable state unless locking is added.
Check permissions before enabling any write connector.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where ai-engineering-hub produces authoritative outputs that taipy consumes, and neither profile shows downstream action authority. Without an observed handoff, cascading error is not supported.
conditions: IF taipy is configured to treat ai-engineering-hub outputs as authoritative inputs, cascading error risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Insert a human verification step between outputs and actions.
Require schema validation on any exchanged artifacts.
Log provenance for any future agent-to-agent handoff.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or PHI/PII handling differences are documented for either ai-engineering-hub or taipy. Since both profiles are docs-only and touch no data classes, a compliance mismatch is not evidenced; the other agent is not separately cited because no single-agent residency violation is shown.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data with different residency or retention requirements, compliance risk must be reassessed.
mitigations: Check vendor residency and retention terms for any regulated workload.
Keep regulated data out of undocumented pipelines.
